record_title: Exact L1 endpoint profile for weighted conditional expectation operators
provenance: The L1 weighted-conditional-expectation operator is decomposed over the atomic/non-atomic decomposition of the conditioning sigma-algebra. Exact block norms yield approximation and Bernstein numbers, ideal distances, complemented l1 witnesses, and an exact nuclear norm. Explicit examples test previously stated endpoint compactness and nuclearity criteria.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Parts of the block decomposition may follow indirectly from older Banach-lattice and multiplication-conditional-expectation representation theory. The result concerns the same-space L1 endpoint; it does not revise the reflexive Lp theory for 1<p<infinity or characterize all weighted conditional operators between distinct Lp spaces.
